stages.Rising: Prices have been beating other metros and are expected to keep doing so
stages.Turning up: Prices have lagged, but the model expects them to start beating other metros
stages.Turning down: Prices have been strong, but the model expects them to fall behind
stages.Falling: Prices have lagged and are expected to keep lagging

Real estate.Rising: Strong market: put agents and listing marketing here.
Real estate.Turning up: Early opportunity: start building listings and agent capacity.
Real estate.Turning down: Expect slower sales soon; prepare sellers for price cuts.
Real estate.Falling: Hold spending; watch for the outlook to turn.

Home improvement retail.Rising: Active market: keep move-in stock (paint, appliances) deep.
Home improvement retail.Turning up: Activity picking up: plan staff and stock ahead of it.
Home improvement retail.Turning down: Fewer moves ahead: shift toward repair and remodel products.
Home improvement retail.Falling: Keep inventory lean; lean on maintenance and pro customers.

Investors.Rising: Strong momentum, but entry prices are already up.
Investors.Turning up: Potential early entry: the outlook is improving before prices show it.
Investors.Falling: Wait for the outlook to improve before buying.

Real estate.Strong: Good market to grow in over the next year: worth adding agents or marketing.
Real estate.Average: Expect a typical year relative to other big metros.
Real estate.Weak: Plan for a slower year here; avoid big new commitments.

Home improvement retail.Strong: Plan for more move-in demand over the next year (staffing, stock, new locations).
Home improvement retail.Average: Expect typical demand relative to other big metros.
Home improvement retail.Weak: Expect fewer moves over the year; lean on repair, remodel and pro customers.

Investors.Strong: Year-ahead outlook favors this market vs. other big metros.
Investors.Average: No clear edge vs. other big metros over the year.
Investors.Weak: Year-ahead outlook is weak: be cautious adding exposure here.
